resume.comment: Gates the --allow-terminal-restart operator flag. Despite the name it covers three recovery paths, all human-invoked (never on automated paths): (1) explicit restart of a completed/fallback/skipped phase, (2) reclaim of a crash-stranded in_progress phase, (3) forced re-entry of a retry-exhausted failed phase — and for that one call it also bypasses the circuit breaker (operator override). Enforced in scripts/transitions.py:validate_transition_request.

qualityRefineLoop.comment: Phase 5 render -> judge-against-the-raw-idea -> fix -> re-render loop (autobot-integration-build Step 9b/9e). A deterministic screen-fill (occupancy) miss or an explicit user-clause violation routes into the buildFixLoop as a layout defect, bounded by maxAttempts; on exhaustion the build advances and the deterministic visual_contract gate hard-fails honestly (badge UNVERIFIED) rather than laundering a low-quality build to DEGRADED. The non-deterministic vision verdict stays DEGRADED-only; only the deterministic occupancy floor blocks.
